scientific_integrity: The general proof is a Myhill-Nerode quotient classification. Finite computation is auxiliary, not an infinite proof. No independent mathematical verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only square roots of the fixed-binary principal scattered-subsequence ideals generated by 00 followed by b ones; not NFA minimality, higher roots, or a general worst-case upper bound. Full text of the 2026 NFA paper was not inspected; historical priority is uncertain.
title: Exact quadratic square-root state complexity for a binary subsequence ideal
